risk_flags.message: reUSDe has no usable on-chain NAV accessor; NAV is an off-chain issuer API value with the API's own timestamp.
Primary exit is a quarterly, regulator-approved capped window; the first window filled its announced pool and was rationed pro rata.
reUSDe is Re Protocol's second-loss mezzanine tranche: Re equity absorbs first, reUSDe second, and reUSD last.
The Curve secondary venue is a cross-currency twocrypto pool against sUSDe; dollar interpretation inherits sUSDe's USD price.

peg.nav_source: Re Protocol off-chain issuer API https://api.re.xyz/apy/get-apy data.reUSDe.currentNAV
peg.nav_basis: Off-chain issuer-published NAV. reUSDe exposes no usable on-chain nav(), getNAV(), totalAssets(), pricePerShare(), convertToAssets(), or exchangeRate() accessor; this is weaker than an issuer-set value that can at least be read on-chain.
peg.market_price_source: CoinGecko API external USD aggregate mid for re-protocol-reusde; off-chain market-data API, distinct from the off-chain issuer NAV API and not a contract read
peg.premium_discount_basis: signed (CoinGecko external market mid - off-chain issuer API NAV) / NAV * 100; no smoothing or clamping
peg.history_basis_note: Historical market prices are compared with issuer API theoretical NAV observations. No quarter-boundary NAV behavior is inferred or asserted.

liquidity.total_tvl_basis: GeckoTerminal reserve_in_usd for the listed Curve twocrypto secondary venue; pool TVL is not executable depth and its USD conversion inherits sUSDe's USD price
liquidity.two_pct_depth_unresponsive_note: No USD exit quote ladder is published because the venue directly prices reUSDe in sUSDe, not dollars.
liquidity.two_pct_depth_basis: Not measured; cross-currency pool TVL is not treated as dollar depth.
liquidity.external_mid_source: CoinGecko API external aggregate mid for re-protocol-reusde

primary_exit.gate: Quarterly redemption window; eligibility and released surplus require regulatory approval
primary_exit.capacity_basis: Announced first-window pool; fixed by released surplus under regulatory approval, not a demand-scaling floor

first_window.result: Filled to the announced ceiling within 0.005%; requests met or exceeded capacity and the window was rationed.

primary_exit.note: The primary exit is periodic and capped, not continuous liquidity.

pools.name: Curve REUSDE/sUSDe
pools.usd_basis: GeckoTerminal USD conversion; the pool directly prices reUSDe in sUSDe, so its dollar mark and TVL inherit sUSDe's own USD price
pools.balance_ratio_basis: Not published: in Curve twocrypto the token split expresses the exchange rate and is not a stableswap imbalance measure.

liquidity.note: No balance_ratio is published. For this Curve twocrypto cross-currency pair, token split is an exchange-rate expression rather than a stableswap imbalance finding.

backing.as_of_basis: Ethereum block time for supply; issuer reserve composition retrieved during this run and its page exposes no component timestamp
backing.collateral_ratio_basis: No tranche-specific collateral ratio is established. The reserve dashboard combines reUSD and reUSDe and does not expose an attributable reUSDe denominator.
backing.total_backing_basis: Not published because no independently attributable reUSDe-only reserve total was established.
backing.nav_claim_value_basis: Ethereum reUSDe totalSupply() multiplied by the off-chain issuer API NAV; this is issuer-marked claim value, not backing.

protocol_reserves_passthrough.scope: issuer-reported combined reUSD + reUSDe reserves; not attributable to reUSDe alone

backing.loss_waterfall: Re equity absorbs first loss; reUSDe mezzanine absorbs second; reUSD senior absorbs last
backing.waterfall_basis: $20M is the loss-waterfall capital quantity. The separately disclosed approximately $77M balance-sheet capital is a different quantity and is not used in the waterfall.

integrity.note: Supply is measured on-chain. NAV and protocol-wide reserve composition are issuer-reported; reserve composition is not used to claim tranche-specific coverage. Subordination is described but not deducted from backing scoring.

upstream.name: Re Protocol off-chain NAV API
upstream.note: No usable on-chain reUSDe NAV accessor exists.

upstream.name: Ethena sUSDe
upstream.metric: 99.05% of issuer-reported combined protocol reserves and the secondary-pool denominator
upstream.note: The reserve percentage is combined reUSD + reUSDe; the secondary USD mark also inherits sUSDe's price.

upstream.name: Off-chain reinsurance trusts and counterparties
upstream.note: Not independently measurable from Ethereum state.
